_about: orbiter's curated loadout facts for warframe suggestions (src/lib/core/builds/suggest.ts, loadoutFor): Archon Shards, Helminth, support weapons, frame arcanes, companions and Focus. Every fact was read by hand on the page named in its `source` (3 Nov 2026); orbiter never fetches these pages. Effects are at max rank. Which pick goes with which frame role is orbiter's own rule in suggest.ts, not the sources'.

shards.tauforgedNote: Tauforged shards give 1.5× the base bonus (from Archon Hunts, Netracells, Deep and Temporal Archimedea, or fusing three of a colour).
shards._tauforgedOnly: orbiter suggests only Tauforged shards, at every tier (orbiter's rule: a plain shard is the same stat at two thirds of the value).

fusion.name: Ascent Fusion
fusion.effect: fuses three shards of the same colour into one Tauforged shard of that colour, in the Helminth

shards._elements: Which element each colour feeds, from the same page. Only Violet (Electricity), Emerald (Corrosion, Toxin) and Topaz (Radiation) raise ability damage or status damage; Topaz's Heat and Blast stats are kill rewards for weapons (secondary crit per Heat-affected kill, health or shields per Blast kill), and no shard has a Cold or Viral stat.

heat.note: No shard raises Heat ability damage; Topaz's Heat stat is secondary crit chance per kill of a Heat-affected enemy (+1.5% Tauforged, to +75%).

blast.note: Topaz's Blast stats give health or shields per Blast kill, not ability damage.

cold.note: No shard has a Cold stat.

viral.note: No shard has a Viral stat.

helminth._about: Iconic cases only: a frame is here when the pages read by hand point the same way; `alt` says where they differ. Prime and Umbra frames can't be subsumed; the base frame is fed to the Helminth (https://www.highgroundgaming.com/warframe-helminth/).

Saryn.alt: The second page replaces Miasma instead, or Molt.
Saryn.why: The usual Helminth pick on the Saryn builds read; Molt is the slot they give up.

Rhino.alt: Nourish builds are common too, and only the first page names Rhino Stomp as the slot.

Mesa.alt: Eclipse in the same slot is the other common pick.
Mesa.why: Ballistic Battery is the slot the Mesa builds read give up.

Wisp.alt: Roar over Sol Gate for a weapon-platform Wisp.
Wisp.why: Sol Gate is the slot the Wisp builds read give up.

grimoire.name: Grimoire
grimoire.note: It came in Update 35.0 (Whispers in the Walls, 2023-12-13) and takes Tome mods on top of normal secondary mods; only one Invocation at a time. Its alternate fire throws a voltaic orb (guaranteed Electricity) and needs a full meter: 45 s, shortened by hits and ammo pickups.

strength.name: Vome Invocation
strength.effect: each enemy the alternate fire hits gives +4% Ability Strength for 20 s, up to 15 stacks (+60%)

energy.name: Xata Invocation
energy.effect: each enemy the alternate fire hits gives 1 Energy/s for 20 s, up to 10 stacks

efficiency.name: Netra Invocation
efficiency.effect: each enemy the alternate fire hits gives +4% Ability Efficiency for 20 s, up to 15 stacks

duration.name: Ris Invocation
duration.effect: each enemy the alternate fire hits gives +4% Ability Duration for 20 s, up to 15 stacks

kitgun.name: Pax Bolt
kitgun.effect: a headshot kill gives +30% Ability Strength and Ability Efficiency to your next ability (within 4 s)
kitgun.note: Kitgun arcanes go only on gilded kitguns, beside the normal weapon arcane; Rude Zuud sells them from Old Mate with Solaris United.

effects.Molt Augmented: +0.24% Ability Strength per kill, up to 250 stacks (+60%).
effects.Arcane Energize: Energy pickups also give you and nearby allies up to 150 energy.
effects.Molt Reconstruct: You and allies in range heal 6 health for each point of energy you spend.
effects.Arcane Grace: 6% health regenerated per second for 9 s.
effects.Molt Vigor: An Operator ability gives +45% Ability Strength to your next Warframe ability.
effects.Molt Efficiency: +6% Ability Duration each second while your shields are up, to +36%; lost when shields break. Despite the name, it's duration, not efficiency (https://wiki.warframe.com/w/Molt_Efficiency).

Nautilus.effect: Cordon pulls enemies within 30 m 15 m toward one point, every 15 s: they bunch up inside your abilities.

Smeeta Kavat.effect: Charm has a 40% chance every 27 s to give a buff; one in five of those is free ability casts (since Update 37.0 it no longer doubles resources).

Panzer Vulpaphyla.effect: When it goes down it turns into a larva that keeps shooting Viral quills, and comes back after 30 s: it stays with you in the thick of it.

focus._about: The five schools: Madurai, Vazarin, Naramon, Unairu, Zenurik (reworked in Update 31.5). The passives named here work while that school is the active one.

Zenurik.effect: Energy Pulse: energy pickups give 50% more energy over 5 s. Inner Might: one ability cast every 60 s costs no energy.

Vazarin.effect: Mending Soul: your first revives are instant. Protective Sling: allies your Void Sling touches are immune to damage for 5 s and heal.

Madurai.effect: Sling Strength: switching back to the Warframe after a Chained Sling gives +40% Ability Strength for 20 s.

kitElements._about: Frames whose catalog ability text carries no element tag (<DT_*_COLOR>), with the element their damage abilities deal, read by hand on the page named. Only frames read are here; the rest are found from the tags.

shieldGating._about: Frames commonly built to shield-gate (break shields, get a moment of invulnerability, refill them by casting), from the page named. A reviewable list, not a rule: any frame with shields can shield-gate.
shieldGating.note: The same page pairs it with Brief Respite or the Augur set, which turn energy spent into shields.

sets._about: Mod sets whose pieces span the frame, its weapons and its companion. Pieces, where each goes and each piece's own effect are the catalog's (each mod's type, compatName and stats); set bonuses were read by hand on the page in `source`. `fit` names orbiter's rule for which frames get the set (suggest.ts, setPicks); null: checked and not suggested by frame role. `replaces`: the plain mod a frame piece stands in for.

Augur.bonus: 40% of the energy you spend on abilities comes back as shields for each piece worn: 160% with the four frame pieces, 240% with all six.
Augur.why: Every cast refills the shields this frame gates on.

Mecha.bonus: Your Kubrow marks an enemy every 60/45/30/15 s (1 to 4 pieces); killing it spreads its status effects to enemies within 7.5/15/22.5/30 m.
Mecha.why: The kit puts status on enemies, and the marked kill spreads it through the group.

Strain.bonus: The Helminth Charger grows 2/4/6/8 cysts (1 to 4 pieces) that erupt every 25 s, each spawning a Maggot that attacks; Strain Consume eats dead Maggots within 10 m for +4% max health and 2 health/s for 45 s.
Strain.why: A health tank that fights in the crowd: the Maggots keep spawning around it and feed its health.

Hunter.bonus: Companions deal +25% damage per piece (+150% with all six) to enemies with a Slash status.
Hunter.why: Hunter Adrenaline turns damage taken on health into energy, for a frame that tanks on health and casts all the time.

Carnis.bonus: A heavy-attack kill gives 10/20/30% evasion and immunity to status effects for 2/4/6 s (1 to 3 pieces).
Carnis.why: Status immunity for a health tank that finishes fights with heavy attacks.

Gladiator.bonus: +10% to +60% melee critical chance per combo multiplier, rising with the pieces worn.
Gladiator.why: A melee build's choice, not a frame role: orbiter doesn't suggest it from the frame.

Vigilante.bonus: Each piece gives primary-weapon critical hits a 5% chance (30% with six) to gain +100% critical chance.
Vigilante.why: A primary weapon's choice, not a frame role.

Jugulus.bonus: Slam attacks raise tendrils that skewer enemies within 3/6/9 m for 25/50/75 Puncture and stun them for 3 s, every 12/9/6 s (1 to 3 pieces).
Jugulus.why: A slam-attack melee choice, not a frame role.

Saxum.bonus: Lifted enemies explode on death for 10/20/30% of their max health as Impact within 4/8/12 m (1 to 3 pieces).
Saxum.why: Pays off with weapons that lift enemies, not with a frame role.

Synth.bonus: Holstered primary and secondary weapons reload 5% of their magazine per second per piece (20% with four), from reserve ammo.
Synth.why: A weapon-handling set, not a frame role.

Umbral.bonus: Each piece raises the others' main stat: by 25% of its value with two pieces, 75% with three.
Umbral.why: All three are Warframe mods: orbiter's high-tier builds already put them in when you hold them.

primers._about: Companions that put status effects on enemies on their own, and how (precept or set piece), read by hand on the pages named. Which frame gets which is orbiter's rule (suggest.ts, primerPicks): the element of the frame's own kit first, else Viral.

Panzer Vulpaphyla.effect: Viral Quills fires 6 quills at enemies within 20 m every 4 s, 60 Viral damage each at 40% status chance; it comes with the companion.

Diriga.effect: Arc Coil zaps up to 7 enemies within 10 m with Electricity, about once a second.

bond.name: Manifold Bond
bond.effect: the companion's abilities also inflict the status effects of your equipped weapon (robotic companions only)

weapon.effect: Cold damage at 36% status chance (the catalog's numbers; Verglas: 34%); with Contagious Bond, enemies the companion kills spread part of their status effects to enemies nearby

Helminth Charger.effect: Its Maggots explode on death for 4% of an enemy's current health as Corrosive within 8 m, always applying Corrosive status (since Update 37.0); its claws add 50 Toxin at 25% status chance.

checkedAndLeftOut.Tek set: The Kavat marks a zone that deals damage; the page read (https://progametalk.com/warframe/tek-mods-guide/) doesn't say how the bonus grows with the pieces, so orbiter doesn't state it.
checkedAndLeftOut.Amar, Boreal and Nira sets: Their pieces are in the catalog (a Warframe mod, an exilus mod and a melee mod each), but their set bonuses weren't read on a page, so orbiter doesn't suggest them.
checkedAndLeftOut.Motus, Proton and Aero sets: Parkour and aim-glide sets: weapon handling in the air, nothing a frame role asks for.
checkedAndLeftOut.Momentous Bond: Eximus kills give the companion a random element for 30 s; the page doesn't give the values (https://wiki.warframe.com/w/Bond_Mods).
checkedAndLeftOut.Pax Charge: Kitgun reload: makes the magazine recharge. Nothing for abilities (https://wiki.warframe.com/w/Pax_Charge).
checkedAndLeftOut.Pax Seeker: Homing projectiles on headshot kills. Weapon damage only (https://wiki.warframe.com/w/Magus_Arcane).
checkedAndLeftOut.Pax Soar: Accuracy, less recoil and aim glide in the air. Weapon handling only (https://wiki.warframe.com/w/Magus_Arcane).
checkedAndLeftOut.Secondary Outburst: Secondary crit chance and damage per melee combo. Nothing for abilities (https://wiki.warframe.com/w/Magus_Arcane).
checkedAndLeftOut.Secondary Encumber: A chance to add a second status effect. A primer's arcane, not strength or energy (https://wiki.warframe.com/w/Magus_Arcane).
checkedAndLeftOut.Laetum: No Incarnon perk touches abilities, strength or energy (https://wiki.warframe.com/w/Laetum).
checkedAndLeftOut.Epitaph: Not an Incarnon weapon on the wiki's Incarnon page (https://wiki.warframe.com/w/Incarnon); some builds use it as a status primer.
checkedAndLeftOut.Energy Generator: Dethcube drops an Energy Orb after 10 kill assists; real but slow, so not suggested (https://wiki.warframe.com/w/Energy_Generator).
